site.name: Mihaylo Dimo
site.description: Wedding, portrait, event and sports photography in Sofia, across Bulgaria and worldwide.

home.title: Wedding, portrait & event photographer
home.hero: The moments you'll want to live again.

story.heading: Every frame, a story crafted with passion.
story.text: Photography is more than pressing the shutter. It's about seeing the unseen, feeling the emotion, and crafting a moment that lives forever. Every wedding is unique, and I take the time to make sure each shot tells a story that's authentically yours.

meet.heading: Meet the eye behind the lens.
meet.text: My name is Mihaylo, and I've spent the past five years capturing love stories with passion and dedication. My approach mixes journalistic storytelling with carefully crafted, moody portraits. I thrive in the fast-paced energy of wedding days, making sure every moment, big or small, is kept with authenticity.

items.q: How do we book a date?
items.a: Send an inquiry with your date and a few details. I'll reply within 2 business days, and once we've agreed on everything, a 30% deposit secures the date.
Yes. Travel is free within Sofia and {rate}/km for the rest of Bulgaria. Celebrations abroad are welcome too: ask and I'll put together a quote.

items.q: When will we see our photos?
items.a: Wedding sneak peeks arrive within 48 hours. Christening galleries follow within 2 weeks, couple sessions within 10 days, and events within 48–72 hours.
Through a private online gallery you can share with family and download from. The Full Day collection uses a Pic-Time gallery with a mobile app, active for a year.

items.q: What if the day runs longer?
items.a: No problem. Extra time is charged per hour: {essential}/hour on the Essential collection and {signature}/hour on Full Day.
